question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Cramped
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4' i.e. **'Extensive'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word **'Cramped'** means feeling or causing someone to feel uncomfortably confined or restricted due to insufficient space. (संकीर्ण)

 
 
• **Example:** She lived in a cramped, tiny apartment in the city.
 
 
 
• The chosen antonym **'Extensive' **signifies a large amount or spread over a great area. (व्यापक)
 
 
• **Example:** Their company has extensive operations across the globe.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is- **Extensive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '**Remote' **often means far-off in distance or out-of-the-way. (दूरस्थ)
 
• **'Vicinity'** means in the area or surrounding location. (आस-पास)
 
• **'Straight' **typically refers direction without a turn or bend. (सीधा)
